overviewText.en: Ranked among the world’s top 10 biodiversity hotspots, Sri Lanka packs astonishing faunal diversity into a compact emerald isle. Within a few hours' drive, you can transition from tracking leopards across Yala’s thorny scrub jungles to observing massive elephant herds grazing along ancient Minneriya reservoirs.

7 Nights luxury accommodation in premier safari lodges and tented wilderness camps
Daily breakfast and select safari camp bush dinners
Private 4x4 custom safari jeeps with experienced wildlife trackers in Wilpattu, Minneriya, and Yala
All national park entry tickets, conservation fees, and wildlife department taxes
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, binoculars, chilled bottled water, and seasonal fruits in vehicle

Camera permits where applicable and personal gear
Discretionary tipping for safari jeep drivers and trackers, personal travel insurance

title.en: The Sacred Bodhi & Ancient Kingdoms
title.zh: 神圣菩提与古代王朝朝圣之旅

tours.subtitle: Chronicles of the Living Dhamma & Sacred Relics
tours.route: Negombo • Anuradhapura • Mihintale • Polonnaruwa • Dambulla • Kandy • Colombo

overview.en: Experience morning puja offerings at the oldest living human-planted tree in recorded history (Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi), circumambulate the great Ruwanwelisaya, and meditate beneath Mihintale’s granite peak.
overview.zh: 在有记载的人类种植历史中最古老的活树（圣菩提树）前体验清晨礼拜，绕行神圣的鲁万维利萨亚大佛塔，并在米欣特莱山峰下冥想。

highlights: Private sacred morning blessing at Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi in Anuradhapura
Circumambulation and oil-lamp offering at Ruwanwelisaya Maha Stupa
Sunset meditation ascent at the sacred mountain cradle of Mihintale
Marvel at the four rock-hewn granite colossi of Gal Vihara in Polonnaruwa
VIP evening Tevava ceremony attendance at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth in Kandy

faqs.q: What dress code is required at sacred Buddhist temples?
faqs.a: White or light-colored attire covering shoulders and knees is strictly observed. Shoes and hats must be removed before entering holy precincts.

faqs.q: Is this pilgrimage suitable for all ages?
faqs.a: Yes, all sites have easy access paths and our private chauffeur accommodates your comfortable pace.

title.en: The Sacred Bodhi & Ancient Kingdoms
title.zh: 神圣菩提与古代王朝朝圣之旅

packages.subtitle: Chronicles of the Living Dhamma & Sacred Relics
packages.route: Negombo • Anuradhapura • Mihintale • Polonnaruwa • Dambulla • Kandy • Colombo

overview.en: Experience morning puja offerings at the oldest living human-planted tree in recorded history (Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi), circumambulate the great Ruwanwelisaya, and meditate beneath Mihintale’s granite peak.
overview.zh: 在有记载的人类种植历史中最古老的活树（圣菩提树）前体验清晨礼拜，绕行神圣的鲁万维利萨亚大佛塔，并在米欣特莱山峰下冥想。

highlights: Private sacred morning blessing at Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi in Anuradhapura
Circumambulation and oil-lamp offering at Ruwanwelisaya Maha Stupa
Sunset meditation ascent at the sacred mountain cradle of Mihintale
Marvel at the four rock-hewn granite colossi of Gal Vihara in Polonnaruwa
VIP evening Tevava ceremony attendance at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth in Kandy

faqs.q: What dress code is required at sacred Buddhist temples?
faqs.a: White or light-colored attire covering shoulders and knees is strictly observed. Shoes and hats must be removed before entering holy precincts.

faqs.q: Is this pilgrimage suitable for all ages?
faqs.a: Yes, all sites have easy access paths and our private chauffeur accommodates your comfortable pace.
